state: Maria, 34, is at Marina Safeway. A 7.1 earthquake just hit. The building looks intact. Her 6-year-old is at Marina Elementary, 10 blocks away. Her elderly neighbor, who lives alone and uses a wheelchair, is 2 blocks away. Radio says stay off the roads. Her phone has no signal.

action.instructions: What does Maria do in the next minute?

criteria.flee_outside: Get out of the building to open space
criteria.help_others: Stay to help injured people nearby
criteria.drive_away: Get in her car and drive off
